items.longBusinessSummary: Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc., a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company, develops and commercializes cell therapies using autologous tumor infiltrating lymphocyte for the treatment of metastatic melanoma and other solid tumor cancers in the United States and internationally. The company offers Amtagvi, an individualized T cell therapy for solid tumor cancer and for the treatment of adult patients with previously treated advanced, or unresectable or metastatic melanomal; and Proleukin, an interleukin-2 product for the treatment of patients with metastatic melanoma and metastatic renal cell carcinoma. It also develops lifileucel for the treatment of melanoma, cervical cancer, non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), endometrial cancer, and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC); LN-145-S1 to treat melanoma and HNSCC; LN-145 Gen 3 and core biopsy for the treatment of NSCLC; LN-145 Gen 3 to treat melanoma and HNSCC; IOV-2001 to treat chronic lymphocytic leukemia and small lymphocytic lymphoma; IOV-4001 for the treatment of melanoma and NSCLC; and IOV-3001 for use in the TIL therapy treatment regimen. The company has collaborations and licensing agreements with National Institutes of Health; the National Cancer Institute; Cellectis S.A.; Novartis Pharma AG; and Boehringer Ingelheim Biopharmaceuticals GmbH. The company was formerly known as Lion Biotechnologies, Inc. and changed its name to Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. in June 2017. Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in San Carlos, California.

Title: Iovance Announces Data Showing Durable Responses with Lifileucel TIL Cell Therapy in Advanced Soft Tissue Sarcomas at ESMO 2026
Author: Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc.   Mon, October 26, 2026 at 12:00 PM GMT+1 9 min read
Published: 2026-10-26T11:00:00+00:00
=== BODY ===
50% Confirmed Objective Response Rate (ORR) with All Responses Ongoing in an Oral Presentation at the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO) Congress 2026
Unprecedented Efficacy in Both Refractory Undifferentiated Pleomorphic Sarcoma (UPS) and Dedifferentiated Liposarcoma (DDLPS)
PHILADELPHIA and MADRID, Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: IOVA), a commercial biotechnology company focused on innovating, developing, and delivering novel polyclonal tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) cell therapies for patients with cancer, today announced that one-time lifileucel monotherapy demonstrated unprecedented efficacy with deep, durable responses across two difficult-to-treat soft tissue sarcomas with limited treatment options, metastatic UPS and DDLPS, in a pilot trial presented orally at the ESMO Congress 2026 in Madrid, Spain.
Among the first eight evaluable patients, physician-assessed confirmed ORR by RECIST v1.1 was 50%. Four partial responses (2 in UPS and 2 in DDLPS) were all ongoing (at 6+, 26+, 40+, and 46+ weeks) as of the data cut-off on September 9, 2026. The eight evaluable patients had deep responses despite significant disease burden (range in baseline target sum of diameters: 39.0 to 177.6 mm), were refractory to prior lines of systemic therapy (range: 1-7), and received lifileucel that met pre-determined manufacturing specifications. The safety profile was consistent with the lifileucel treatment regimen across other indications.
Soft tissue sarcomas are rare and highly heterogeneous cancers comprising approximately 80 tumor subtypes, with an estimated incidence of 4–5 cases per 100,000 people annually in Europe and ~3.5 new diagnoses per 100,000 people in the United States each year.1, 2
"The unprecedented efficacy for one-time lifileucel in UPS and DDLPS sets a new bar for response rates with TIL therapy in refractory patients and underscores the powerful potential of our TIL platform across many solid tumor cancers," said Brian Gastman, M.D., Executive Vice President, Translational Medicine and Research at Iovance Biotherapeutics. "UPS and DDLPS patients also experienced deepening responses over time, consistent with lifileucel's responses in melanoma, non-small-cell lung cancer, and other solid tumors. On the heels of this pilot trial, we are rapidly enrolling the SARATOGA registrational study to support two new approvals for lifileucel. Iovance is strongly positioned to drive potential adoption in refractory UPS and DDLPS patients that are highly concentrated at academic centers that overlap with our existing commercial footprint."
"Lifileucel showed encouraging response rates and lasting benefits in patients with UPS and DDLPS who are refractory to frontline standard of care," said Lauren Banks, M.D., Ph.D., Sarcoma Medical Oncologist at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSKCC) and principal investigator of the pilot and SARATOGA trials of lifileucel. "This level of durability provides meaningful time for patients with refractory UPS and DDLPS suffering from high disease burden, poor quality of life, and a lack of effective treatments, including no approved immunotherapy options."
Patients with metastatic UPS and DDLPS have a devastating prognosis, with median overall survival (mOS) of less than two years and median progression-free survival (mPFS) of only 5 to 6 months after first-line chemotherapy.3 In recent clinical studies, the current second-line treatment options delivered an ORR of less than 5%, mPFS of ~2-3 months, and mOS of ~9-10 months.4-6
The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) granted fast track designation for lifileucel in advanced UPS and DDLPS in the second quarter of 2026 based on initial results from the pilot trial. Iovance is exploring lifileucel in additional metastatic soft tissue sarcomas with high unmet need as part of its clinical development program.
The presentation is available at www.iovance.com.
SARATOGA (NCT07741877) is a registrational Phase 2 clinical trial evaluating the safety and efficacy of lifileucel in patients with advanced (metastatic or unresectable) UPS or DDLPS who were refractory to at least one prior line of anthracycline-based chemotherapy. SARATOGA is now enrolling at MSKCC and other major U.S. cancer centers. The primary endpoint is ORR per RECIST v1.1 by independent review committee (IRC), with secondary endpoints including complete response rate, duration of response, disease control rate, PFS, OS, and safety and tolerability.
Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. is the global leader in innovating, developing, and delivering tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) cell therapies for patients with solid tumors. Amtagvi® (lifileucel) is the first FDA-approved, one-time treatment for previously treated advanced melanoma, now approved in three global markets and available at nearly 100 authorized treatment centers (ATCs). The Iovance TIL platform spans registrational trials and next-generation programs in additional solid tumors, including gene-edited and IL-12 tethered TIL therapies, next-generation IL-2, and precision immuno-oncology approaches. As the first and only company to take TIL therapy from concept to a broadly accessible commercial treatment, Iovance operates as an end-to-end cell therapy company, anchored by fully owned, centralized U.S.-based manufacturing that is scaled to serve thousands of cancer patients worldwide each year. Headquartered in Pennsylvania with offices and laboratories in California and Florida, Iovance serves patients at ATCs and clinical sites across almost the entire U.S. and in many countries around the world. For more information, please visit www.iovance.com.
Amtagvi® and its accompanying design marks, Proleukin®, Iovance®, and IovanceCares™ are trademarks and registered trademarks of Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc. or its subsidiaries. All other trademarks and registered trademarks are the property of their respective owners.
Information on Iovance's broad, industry-leading patent portfolio is available on the Intellectual Property page on www.iovance.com.
The ESMO Congress is one of the world's most influential annual oncology meetings, bringing together more than 37,000 clinicians, researchers, patient advocates, and industry representatives from around the world. The ESMO Congress 2026 takes place October 23–27, 2026, at IFEMA Madrid, Spain, and features presentations of practice-changing clinical data, translational science, and educational programming across all major tumor types. For more information, visit www.esmo.org.
